claim.claim-text: a device having defined therein an analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062), the device comprising an input connection (415, 515, 615, 715, 815, 915, 1015) for receiving a sample into the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062); and a spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) disposed in the device and defining a portion of a boundary of the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) at a side of the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062), the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) providing an optical analysis device with optical access to the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) to optically interrogate at least a portion of the sample within the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) by passing emitted optical energy through the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) into the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) and receiving returned optical energy that is returned from the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) through the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060).
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the side is a first side, and wherein a second side of the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) opposite the first side is devoid of any additional lenses.

3. The system of claim 1, wherein the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) is sealed into an orifice (425, 625, 825, 1025) defined in the device at the portion of the boundary of the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062) by at least one of an elastomer, a polymer, an adhesive, or a metal that is deformable, and wherein the sample is prevented from leaking between the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) and the orifice (425, 625, 825, 1025).
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) is configured to:

allow the emitted optical energy emitted from the optical analysis device to pass through the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) in a first direction into the analysis region (462, 662, 862, 1062); and allow the returned optical energy to pass through the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) in a second direction to the optical analysis device, the second direction opposite the first direction.

5. The system of claim 1, further comprising the optical analysis device, the optical analysis device comprising an optical emitter portion and an optical receiver portion, the optical emitter portion configured to emit the emitted optical energy toward the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060), and the optical receiver portion configured to receive the returned optical energy via the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060).
6. The system of claim 1, wherein the optical analysis device is a Raman spectrometer.
7. The system of claim 1, wherein the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) comprises at least one of a glass or a polymer.

8. The system of claim 1, wherein the input connection (415, 515, 615, 715, 815, 915, 1015) couples to a component of a fluidic system, the component of the fluidic system comprising at least one of a pressure fitting, a tapered threaded device, a parallel threaded device, a quick-connect device, a face-sealed device, a piston sealed device, a ferrule compression device, a conical device, a coned-and-threaded device, a welded device, a brazed device, or a soldered device.
9. The system of claim 1, wherein a body of the device comprises a polymer.
10. The system of claim 1, wherein the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) is attached to a body of the device by an adhesive.
11. The system of claim 1, wherein a body of the device is made of a same material as the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060).

12. A method comprising: receiving a sample within an analysis zone that is defined in a device, wherein the analysis zone (462, 662, 862, 1062) is bounded at a side of the analysis zone (462, 662, 862, 1062) by at least a portion of a surface of a spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) mounted in a body of the device, and

conducting an optical interrogation of the sample in the analysis zone (462, 662, 862, 1062) by: passing emitted optical energy that is emitted from an optical analysis device through the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060) into the analysis zone (462, 662, 862, 1062); and collecting returned optical energy that is returned to the optical analysis device through the spherical lens (460, 560, 660, 760, 860, 960, 1060).
13. The method of claim 12, wherein the conducting of the optical interrogation further comprises analyzing the returned optical energy.

14. The method of claim 12, wherein the side is a first side, and wherein the analysis zone (462, 662, 862, 1062) does not include any additional lenses at a second side of the analysis zone (462, 662, 862, 1062) opposite the first side.
15. The method of claim 12, wherein the optical analysis device comprises a Raman spectrometer removably connected to the device.
